title: To Have and to Hold
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 6 "larks allemande right once around to a long ocean wave in center of larks" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 1 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 3 "pass through across the set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 4 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: swing starts before a waiting couple finishes crossing.
Row 5 "circle left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 9 "partners meltdown swing Or balance & swing or just swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
